description.narrative: The project supports the organisation of the documentary films festival focused on the human rights issues (corruption/LGBT/LAW enforcement). Initially staged in the capital, it travells throughout Ukraine to expand the udience.This is a phase 2 of the contribution that initially started in 2012.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The project aims at encouraging the Ukrainian society for an open dialogue about human rights, strengthening of universal values and the supremacy of law, understanding of human dignity as the great value, inspire the citizens of Ukraine to active, competent and responsible actions for human rights protection and prevention of authoritarianism and dictatorship in Ukraine and combatting corruption ideology. The Film Festival and accompanied seminars stimulate the societal development and fostering human values.
